name: jumphp/effects
description: Screen effects for JumPHP games: transitions (fade, wipes, iris, blinds, dissolve), a flash, a vignette, easing curves

jumphp.name: Effects

effects.doc: The flash: its colour and how long it fades

jumphp.summary: Fades, wipes, an iris and a dissolve to change scene, a flash, a vignette and easing curves: all drawn with translucent rectangles.
features: Transitions: fade, wipe (4 sides), iris on a point, blinds, dissolve; cover, change the scene under it, reveal
Flash: light the screen in a colour, it fades
Ease: 10 curves (quad, cubic, back, bounce, elastic) and lerp
Pure PHP, 32-bit safe: the same in the browser
jumphp.example:
$this->transition->cover('iris', 0.6, '#000000', fn () => $this->scenes()->switchTo(PlayScene::class, [], false));
// the new scene's enter(): $this->transition->reveal('iris', 0.6);
